Callout.Name: Patient Who Can Talk
Callout.Message: Person collapsed but conscious, wants to explain before you treat them.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, no obvious injury, refusing to be moved.

Script.Line: Do not move me yet. Not until I have said this.
I take tablets. The blue ones, twice a day. I have not had them since Thursday.
I feel like I am going to be sick.
Thank you. I am ready now.

Callout.Patient: It went tight and then it went numb. It is going again now.

Lines.Briefing: She can talk, which is information. Listen before you treat.
Lines.Approach: She is awake and she wants to talk to you before anybody touches her.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
